name: Cladribine (Advanced Systemic Mastocytosis)
disease: Advanced systemic mastocytosis (ASM, SM-AHN, mast cell leukemia)
histology: advanced systemic mastocytosis: aggressive SM (ASM), SM with an associated hematologic neoplasm (SM-AHN), or mast cell leukemia (MCL), including disease requiring rapid cytoreduction/debulking

biomarkers.KIT: cladribine (a purine nucleoside analog) has cytotoxic activity across SM subtypes irrespective of KIT mutation status (used off-label; not FDA-approved for SM)
biomarkers.note: Cladribine is an 'Other Recommended' option for advanced SM, useful when rapid debulking of disease is required. It is not a KIT-targeted agent, so imatinib-resistance mutations (KIT D816V) do not preclude it. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Systemic Mastocytosis, SM-6 (ASM) / SM-7 (SM-AHN) and the Discussion.

lineOfTherapy: 'Other Recommended' cytoreductive option for advanced SM; particularly when rapid debulking is required, or as a subsequent-line option

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: advanced systemic mastocytosis (ASM, SM-AHN, or MCL), especially when rapid debulking of disease is required
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, SM-6/SM-7 (Other Recommended: Cladribine) footnote aa (for patients with advanced SM, cladribine may be useful when rapid debulking of disease is required); masto lines 518, 638, 659

drugs.name: Cladribine
drugs.route: IV or SC (per prescribing information / institutional protocol)

provenance.locator: SM-6/SM-7 (Other Recommended: Cladribine); footnote u (refer to package insert for full prescribing information, dose modifications, and monitoring); footnote aa (useful when rapid debulking required); Discussion MS-18 (masto line 2883, cladribine used off-label)

drugs.notes: DOSE IS VERIFY. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Systemic Mastocytosis v3.2026 names cladribine as an Other Recommended option for advanced SM (SM-6/SM-7) and directs to the package insert for dosing (footnote u); it does NOT print an SM-specific cladribine dose, and the Discussion (MS-18) confirms off-label use without a stated dose. DeVita 12th ed. gives cladribine 0.1 mg/kg/day as a 7-day continuous IV infusion (or the same total dose over 5 days as a 2-hour infusion) - but that dose is stated for HAIRY CELL LEUKEMIA (line 281734), NOT for SM, so it is NOT adopted here. The SM basis/dose/unit/schedule must be VERIFY-ed against a cited SM source or the prescribing information before use; not invented. ISMP tall-man for the co-listed antimetabolite is cytarabine / vinBLAStine where those drugs are used - cladribine itself has no tall-man form.

supportiveCare: Cladribine SM dosing, schedule, and cycle count are not printed in the provided sources (NCCN directs to the package insert, SM-6 footnote u) - resolve/VERIFY before use.
Purine-analog immunosuppression: expect lymphopenia and prolonged CD4 suppression - PJP and antiviral prophylaxis and infection monitoring per institutional protocol.
Tumor lysis / rapid mast cell debulking precautions given the cytoreductive indication (hydration, monitoring); mast cell mediator-release precautions.

monitoring: infection surveillance (opportunistic infections from prolonged lymphocyte suppression)
serum tryptase and mast cell disease burden (response)
tumor lysis labs during rapid debulking

doseModificationRules.text: Hold and manage per prescribing information (SM-6 footnote u); the specific SM dose/schedule is VERIFY. Obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 281734 (cladribine 0.1 mg/kg/day continuous IV for 7 days, or the same total dose as a 2-hour infusion over 5 days) - stated for HAIRY CELL LEUKEMIA, not SM; cited only to document that no SM-specific cladribine dose is established in the provided sources

guideline.locator: SM-6 (ASM Other Recommended: Cladribine or Peginterferon alfa-2a +/- Prednisone); SM-7 (SM-AHN); footnote u (refer to package insert for dosing); footnote aa (rapid debulking); Discussion MS-18 (cladribine off-label, ORR data); masto lines 518, 638, 659, 2883

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for cladribine in advanced systemic mastocytosis (ASM/SM-AHN/MCL), a rare mast-cell disorder, used when rapid cytoreduction/debulking is required. Cladribine is a source-named 'Other Recommended' option (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Systemic Mastocytosis v3.2026, SM-6/SM-7), but the guideline directs to the package insert for dosing (footnote u) and the provided sources do NOT print an SM-specific dose or schedule; the DeVita hairy-cell-leukemia dose (0.1 mg/kg/day) is deliberately NOT adopted for SM. Therefore basis/dose/unit/schedule/cycles are set to the literal VERIFY and listed in verifyFields, which blocks status ACTIVE until an SM-specific dose is sourced - no dose is invented. BIOMARKER NOTE: cladribine is a non-targeted purine analog effective across SM subtypes irrespective of KIT status. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
